prompt.zh-TW: 下面三個問題，哪一個最該翻開晴川花坊的資產負債表來回答？
prompt.en: Which of the following questions is best answered by opening Clearwater Florist’s balance sheet?

text.zh-TW: 今天帳上有多少現金、還欠花農多少貨款？
text.en: How much cash is in the account today, and how much is still owed to the growers?

short.zh-TW: 今天有多少現金、欠花農多少
short.en: How much cash there is and how much is owed today

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。「今天有多少、欠多少」是某一天的存量，正是資產負債表的內容。
feedback.en: Nice work. How much is held and owed today is a stock on a given day, exactly what the balance sheet shows.

text.zh-TW: 這一季的花禮生意賺了多少？
text.en: How much did the flower-gift business earn this quarter?

short.en: How much was earned this quarter

feedback.zh-TW: 這是個重要的問題，這點沒錯。不過「這一季賺了多少」是一段期間的事，要看損益表；資產負債表只有季底那一天的狀況。
feedback.en: That is an important question, that much is right. But how much was earned this quarter is a matter of a period, which the income statement answers; the balance sheet shows only the position on the last day of the quarter.

text.zh-TW: 這一季的現金是從哪些活動進來、用到哪裡去？
text.en: Which activities brought cash in this quarter, and where did it go?

short.en: How cash came in and went out this quarter

feedback.zh-TW: 這也是現金的問題，這點沒錯。不過它問的是一段期間現金「怎麼流動」，要看現金流量表；資產負債表只告訴你季底剩下多少。
feedback.en: That is a cash question too, that much is right. But it asks how cash moved over a period, which is the statement of cash flows; the balance sheet only tells you how much is left at quarter end.

explanation.zh-TW: 先分辨問題問的是「某一天」還是「一段期間」。{{term:tm_sf72dfsv}}回答某一天擁有多少、欠多少，所以該翻它來回答的是{{option:o_q2mh}}這個問題。{{option:o_cjzy}}問的是一段期間的利益，{{option:o_863z}}問的是一段期間的現金流動，各自屬於另外兩張表。
explanation.en: First decide whether the question is about one day or a period. The {{term:tm_sf72dfsv}} answers what is held and owed on a given day, so it is the statement to open for {{option:o_q2mh}}. {{option:o_cjzy}} asks about profit over a period and {{option:o_863z}} about cash movements over a period; each belongs to one of the other two statements.
